title: test(objectql): pin the item seam's per-arrival judgement of a dependent's bundle members
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbGfxE9QQTsFJp457cGiCViY)_

Fixes #32901

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:只加注释与测试，不改行为。条目门(`registerItem`)旁写明：依赖包要在 manifest 里声明它加入别人邮件模板包的成员；不声明而逐条注册时按到达逐条判定，顺序会影响结果。
- 为什么改:实测发现，成员在 manifest 里声明时两种顺序都放行，两道门一致；只有不声明、逐条直接注册时才按顺序分歧。席位裁定选项 A：保留逐条判定，写明规则并钉住现状。
- 风险与回滚:零运行时风险(注释在构建产物中零命中)；回滚即还原本 PR 两个文件。
- 先看:`packages/objectql/src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-flow-family.test.ts` 末尾新增的 describe;`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` 条目门注释段。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-flow-family.test.ts -t "another package's bundle"`，预期 4 passed。
- 需要你做的:无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`: a comment in `registerItem`'s bare-name item seam, and no code change. It says the seam judges a bundled type's arrival on the holding as it stands and never reads members still to come. A dependent declares its members of another package's bundle in its manifest: the package door then judges them as one set, and its claim exempts later arrivals at the item seam. Undeclared members registered one by one are judged per arrival, which is order-dependent under ADR-0150 D9's addition test.
- `packages/objectql/src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-flow-family.test.ts`: one new top-level describe, using the file's real kernel and manifest-service harness. Shape: alpha ships `welcome` en-US; beta, in another namespace, depends on alpha.
  - declared in beta's manifest, de-DE then en-US: installs, and beta holds both members
  - declared, en-US then de-DE: the same
  - undeclared, de-DE then en-US: de-DE is refused with 422 `BareNameConflictError` naming alpha (envelope asserted: `code`, `status`, both holders); en-US is then admitted
  - undeclared, en-US then de-DE: both admitted

No changeset: `skip-changeset`. The diff publishes nothing (measurement under Verification).

## Tests

<details><summary>New describe, objectql package suite and typecheck</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-flow-family.test.ts -t "another package's bundle"`: Tests 4 passed | 86 skipped (90), exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test` (os-verify-lock, VERDICT command-exit 0): Test Files 596 passed (596), Tests 13140 passed (13140).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit && pnpm check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` on the two files: exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: the package door's claim dropped</summary>

Through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, on committed head f9c26abab. Anchor `if (selfId !== undefined) this.recordBareNameClaims(selfId, manifest);`, replaced by a no-op: anchor 1 to 0, blob 6f4fbf994cd0 to d778688a7717. The test imports `./registry.js` from source, so no dist was involved.

```text
× declared in the manifest, de-DE then en-US: installs, and beta holds both members
AssertionError: expected BareNameConflictError: Bare-name conflict… { …(8) } to be undefined
Tests  1 failed | 3 passed | 86 skipped (90)
```

That is the expected direction: without the claim, the declared de-DE-first arm falls back to per-arrival judgement and is refused, while the other three pins hold. Restored: blob after restore equals HEAD (6f4fbf994cd0), and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The order-independent item door was ruled out (seat routing ruling, option A).** On main b76df9a69, a package whose manifest declares the members is admitted in either order: the package door judges the set and its claim exempts the item seam. The planned fix from 6879377769 (count the manifest's declared members at the item door) was measured as a throwaway mutation and changed none of the four answers. The only split is undeclared one-by-one registration after the seal, where the door cannot know later members. Options B (a batch item door, widening) and C (refuse undeclared members in every order, narrowing) were not taken. The analysis is in report 6893261716.
- **Loose end (observation, code reading only, not filed):** once a package holds a bundled name through registered members alone, its later members skip the item seam's judgement (the reload exemption). Unregistering the shared member (en-US) could then leave a held de-DE that was never judged as an addition. No public-door repro.

## Verification

`@objectstack/objectql` `files` = `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`. After a fresh `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql build` (DTS rebuilt): `never reads members still to come` matched 0 files and `order-dependent under D9` matched 0 files. The positive control `bareNameHoldersOtherThan` matched 6 files. The neighbouring older comment, `which holds nothing and is refused nothing`, also matched 0 files, so in-body comments do not ship.

</details>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on head f9c26abab: 62 commands, derived from the 2 paths against merge base b76df9a69. All 62 were run with the exit captured before any pipe: 61 exited 0, and `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it needs the whole workspace built). That one is NOT MEASURED locally and left to CI. `--ran` reconciliation: "62 derived famil(ies) accounted for, 61 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)". Main then merged in at 41a849667 (one commit, spec contracts only, nothing on these paths), and the touched test file was rerun on that head: Tests 90 passed (90).

</details>
